== Biography ==
Martha Steele Glasgow was born on 18 September 1810. The Peoria county history identifies Martha (Glasgow), born in Adams County, Ohio, in 1810, as the wife of John McCullough and mother of [[McCullough-6646|William Steele McCullough]], born there on 26 September 1835. The same account names William’s maternal grandfather as [[Glasgow-8|Robert Glasgow]].<ref name="peoria1902">David McCulloch, editor, ''Historical Encyclopedia of Illinois and History of Peoria County'', vol. II (Chicago and Peoria: Munsell Publishing Company, 1902), “William Steele McCullough”; [https://genealogytrails.com/ill/peoria/bio/biosMc.html Genealogy Trails published transcription], accessed 23 October 2026. Transcription inspected; printed original and page number not verified.</ref>

The matching son, husband, birth year and place, and later Logan Township family identify this Martha with the daughter of [[Glasgow-8|Robert Barclay Glasgow]]. Her existing death date is 5 June 1873; the differing year in the county-history transcription is discussed below.

== Research Notes ==
=== Peoria family evidence, 23 October 2026 ===

The 1902 county-history account provides a named maternal-grandfather statement within the matching McCullough family. John is described as born in Rockbridge County, Virginia, in 1804 and dying in Logan Township in 1874. The combination of these family details with Martha’s 1810 Adams County birth and William’s exact birth date supports identification of the named grandfather Robert Glasgow with [[Glasgow-8|Robert Barclay Glasgow]].<ref name="peoria1902" />

The complete Martha-to-Robert father pair is assessed at 94% (strongly supported/confident), superseding the 22 October 2026 assessment of 78% (probable) below. This exact percentage is a subjective evidence assessment. The source supplies explicit kinship; identifying the named Robert with this particular Robert also uses the established family chronology and locality. It is a retrospective published account inspected through a transcription, rather than a contemporary birth register. The earlier tree-only limitation no longer describes the combined father evidence. No biological-mother assessment changes.

The transcription says Martha died in 1872, conflicting with 5 June 1873. That discrepancy remains unresolved: the printed original and a death or burial record should be checked before replacing the existing date. No printed page number has been verified. The parents’ family register remains a useful additional check.

=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-8]] is assessed at 78% (probable). Martha Steele’s 18 September 1810 birth fits Robert Barclay Glasgow and Rosanna Finley’s Adams County family account, near the start of their detailed child sequence. The distinctive middle name strengthens household consistency.

Probable inherited family placement; the capture does not quote a contemporary parent clause.

Next useful test: Check the parents’ family register for Martha’s entry.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-11 WikiTree profile export for Glasgow-11]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
